test_inputs.explanation: The agent navigated repeatedly to the Magento admin product grid at http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/admin/catalog_product/ and opened an Edit page for product id 2784 (seen in URLs .../edit/id/2784/ and .../edit/store/0/id/2784/). The agent also visited the New product URL with set 4 and type simple (.../new/set/4/type/simple/). These values (grid URL, product id 2784, attribute set 4, and simple product type) are provided so the tool can reproduce the same actions; open_result_index is set to 1 to target the first visible result after filtering by ID.
